## Notes

Per-item local and remote storage, supply, and demand settings; up to 100 logistics drones and 10 logistics vessels per station; vessels warp between stars after Logistics Carrier Engine level 4 using Space Warpers; pairing priority is point-to-point, then interstellar routes, then groups.
